title: 1988 Aardvark Vanaheim Comics Cerebus Jaka’s Story 1 Sept Issue 114 Dave Sim
descriptionText:
This is a rare and highly collectible comic book from Aardvark-Vanaheim, featuring the character Cerebus in the September 1988 issue of Jaka’s Story. Written and illustrated by Dave Sim, this US comic tradition is a must-have for any serious collector. The comic book is numbered and in excellent condition, making it a valuable addition to any comic book collection. 

With its unique genre and series title, this comic book is a true gem for fans of US comics. The artist/writer Dave Sim is renowned for his work, and this issue of Jaka’s Story is no exception. Don't miss out on the opportunity to own a piece of comic book history.
